title: The Value It Had at the Start: Initial Properties, Component.onCompleted and the Property That Is Required

questions.question: A limit is set from C++ after create(). Component.onCompleted read it. What did it see?
options: The default: it ran during create(), before the set
questions.explanation: It saw 1, and the limit was 5.

questions.question: A binding doubled: limit * 2 reads the same property. What does it give after the late set?
options: The new one: a binding follows

questions.question: What does create() return for a component with a required property that was not given?
options: Null, with Required property limit was not initialized

questions.question: Why does create_with check every name before it sets any?
options: The engine only warns about a name that is not a property, so a typo would set nothing and go on
questions.explanation: limt and nothing_like_this were refused together.

questions.question: What does the completion do that the beginning does not?
options: Runs Component.onCompleted, once, after the initial properties are set

questions.question: A Repeater makes many copies of a component. How do they get their values?
options: From the QML, or a model: create_with is for one object made from C++
questions.explanation: The lesson says so under what it does not do.
